issue: Patient on insulin (Humulin N since 1998) with diabetes mellitus history has a screening HbA1c flagged HIGH, which would meet exclusion EXCL30, yet the numeric value (0.083) lies inside the stated reference range (0.042–0.112).
query_text: The screening HbA1c on 2014-01-29 (SCREENING 1) is recorded as 0.083 (fraction) with a reference range of 0.042–0.112, but the result is flagged HIGH. The patient has diabetes mellitus in medical history and is recorded as taking Humulin N 20 IU since 1998. Exclusion criterion EXCL30 excludes insulin-dependent diabetic patients with a central laboratory HbA1c above the reference range. Please confirm the correct HbA1c value, reference range and flag from the central laboratory report, and confirm whether the patient met EXCL30 at entry. If an eligibility deviation or waiver applies, please document it.

issue: Two NAUSEA records have the same start and end dates (2014-03-14) and severity but conflicting outcomes; one says NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED even though it has an end date.
query_text: Two adverse event records report NAUSEA, both starting and ending on 2014-03-14, both MILD, relationship REMOTE. One has outcome RECOVERED/RESOLVED and the other NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED, even though an end date is entered. Please clarify whether these are two separate episodes or a duplicate entry. If they are a duplicate, please remove one. If they are separate, please correct the outcome and/or end date so they agree.

issue: Disposition says discontinuation due to ADVERSE EVENT on 2014-04-22, but no adverse event records any action taken with study drug, so the AE that led to withdrawal cannot be identified.
query_text: The Disposition form records the reason for discontinuation as ADVERSE EVENT at WEEK 12 (2014-04-22); last dose was 2014-04-21. On the Adverse Events form, action taken with study drug is blank for every event, including APPLICATION SITE REACTION (start 2014-04-21, moderate, ongoing) and SINUS BRADYCARDIA (start 2014-04-22, mild, ongoing). Please identify which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation, and update action taken with study drug on the relevant AE record(s) to match.

issue: Amlodipine for HYPERTENSION was started on study (2014-03-13), the day after standing systolic BP of 180/179 mmHg, but hypertension is not recorded in medical history or as an adverse event.
query_text: Amlodipine 5 mg was started on 2014-03-13 with indication HYPERTENSION. At the WEEK 4 visit on 2014-03-12, standing systolic blood pressure was 180 and 179 mmHg (supine 160 mmHg). Hypertension is not recorded in medical history or on the Adverse Events form. Please clarify whether the hypertension was pre-existing (and if so, add it to medical history) or a new or worsened condition on study that should be reported as an adverse event. If neither applies, please confirm the indication.

issue: Week 6 glucose of 23.98 mmol/L (1.73 x ULN, flagged HIGH) has no corresponding adverse event and no statement on clinical significance.
query_text: The WEEK 6 glucose on 2014-03-26 was 23.98 mmol/L (reference range 2.8–13.9 mmol/L, flagged HIGH). Other on-study values ranged from 8.10 to 12.43 mmol/L. No related adverse event is recorded. Please confirm whether the investigator judged this result clinically significant. If so, please record an adverse event; if not, please document this assessment.

issue: Humulin N appears as nine identical, uncoded concomitant medication records with no indication.
query_text: HUMULIN N 20.0 IU, start 1998, no end date, is entered nine times with identical details, and every entry has a blank indication. Please confirm whether these are duplicates and remove the extras. Please also add the indication and the dosing frequency so the record can be coded.
